tools.name: polypad_what_can_i_do
tools.title: What can I do
tools.description: Start here. Explains what Polypad on Robinhood Chain can do from chat, example requests, live counts, how signing works, and the guardrails.

tools.name: polypad_intent
tools.title: Understand a request
tools.description: Turns a plain-language request ("buy 0.01 ETH of POLYCAT", "launch a fund with POLYDASH") into the right tool call. Runs read-only requests directly. For actions that move funds it needs the wallet address in `from`; if details are missing it returns the questions to ask.

text.description: What the user said, as written.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key.

ref.description: Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

tools.name: polypad_list_tokens
tools.title: Browse tokens
tools.description: Trending, new, graduating, or high-volume token launches on Polypad, with search. Counts activity from on-chain trades. No price predictions.

sort.description: trending, new, graduating, volume, or graduated.

q.description: Search by name, symbol, or address.

agentLaunched.description: Only tokens prepared through the agent API.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 50. Default 12.

tools.name: polypad_get_token
tools.title: Token details
tools.description: One token: price reading, bonding-curve progress, creator, fees, and links. Accepts a symbol, name, token address, or launch address.

token.description: Symbol, name, token address, or launch address.

tools.name: polypad_token_protections
tools.title: Token protections in plain words
tools.description: A plain-language read of a token's on-chain protections: liquidity, fees, creator holdings, staking pool, vesting lock, bond. It says what is met, what is not, and what it cannot tell you. Not a promise about price.

token.description: Symbol, name, token address, or launch address.

tools.name: polypad_quote_trade
tools.title: Quote a buy or sell
tools.description: Quote a buy (ETH in) or sell (token amount in) for a launch token, on the bonding curve or in the Uniswap V4 pool after graduation. Returns expected output, minimum after slippage, and fees. A reading, not a promise.

token.description: Symbol, name, token address, or launch address.

amount.description: Base units as a decimal string: wei of ETH for a buy, token base units (18 decimals) for a sell.

amountEth.description: Buy only: ETH as a decimal such as 0.01. Use instead of amount.

slippageBps.description: Slippage limit in basis points. Default 100, maximum 1000.

tools.name: polypad_prepare_buy
tools.title: Prepare a buy
tools.description: Prepares a buy of a launch token with ETH. Simulates it on-chain before returning. Returns the unsigned transaction (to, data, value, chainId 4663, gas estimate), a plain summary, and a one-tap signing link. Show the summary before the link. Never signs.

token.description: Symbol, name, token address, or launch address.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key.

amountEth.description: ETH to spend, as a decimal such as 0.01.

amountWei.description: ETH to spend in wei. Use instead of amountEth.

slippageBps.description: Slippage limit in basis points. Default 100, maximum 1000.

confirmLarge.description: Set true only after the user confirmed an amount above 1 ETH.

ref.description: Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

tools.name: polypad_prepare_sell
tools.title: Prepare a sell
tools.description: Prepares a sale of a launch token for ETH, with the exact-amount approval step if needed. Simulates step 1 on-chain. Returns unsigned transactions, a summary, and a signing link. Accepts an amount or a percent of the wallet balance.

token.description: Symbol, name, token address, or launch address.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key.

amount.description: Token base units (18 decimals) as a decimal string.

percentOfBalance.description: Percent of the wallet balance, 1 to 100. Use instead of amount.

slippageBps.description: Slippage limit in basis points. Default 100, maximum 1000.

ref.description: Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

tools.name: polypad_list_nfts
tools.title: Browse NFT collections
tools.description: Polypad NFT collections with status (commitment window, public mint, sold out), price, supply, and royalties.

q.description: Search by name, symbol, or address.

tools.name: polypad_list_nft_listings
tools.title: Browse marketplace listings
tools.description: Active fixed-price NFT listings on the Polypad marketplace, lowest price at the top, optionally for one collection or under a price.

maxPriceEth.description: Only listings at or below this many ETH.

tools.name: polypad_prepare_nft_buy
tools.title: Prepare an NFT buy or mint
tools.description: Prepares either a marketplace purchase (listingId) or a public mint from a fixed-price collection (collection + quantity). Checks supply, wallet limits, and price, then simulates. Returns unsigned transactions, a summary, and a signing link. Collections still in their commitment window are sent to the collection page instead.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key.

collection.description: Collection address for a public mint.

collectionName.description: Collection name, if no address is known.

quantity.description: How many to mint, 1 to 50. Default 1.

confirmLarge.description: Set true only after the user confirmed an amount above 1 ETH.

ref.description: Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

tools.name: polypad_list_fund_templates
tools.title: Fund templates
tools.description: The published strategy templates a fund can be created from: allowed assets, position and trade caps, performance fee, drawdown brake, and manager lock.

tools.name: polypad_list_funds
tools.title: Discover funds
tools.description: Polypad Funds with filters: open for minting, status, template, asset held, manager, factory, search, and sort by newest, raise progress, deadline, or shares.

open.description: Only funds currently raising and not sold out.

asset.description: Asset symbol or address the fund may hold, such as POLYDASH.

q.description: Search by name, symbol, or address.

tools.name: polypad_get_fund
tools.title: Fund details
tools.description: One fund: status, raise progress, price per share, fees, assets, template rules, and whether public minting is open.

tools.name: polypad_prepare_fund_create
tools.title: Prepare a fund launch
tools.description: Prepares creating a fund from a published template (Phase 6 factory by default). Give templateId, or list the assets wanted and it matches a template, or tells you honestly that none can hold them. Returns the unsigned createFund transaction, what the manager must mint next, and a signing link.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key.

assets.description: Asset symbols the fund should hold, used to match a template.

mintPriceEth.description: Price per share in ETH, a decimal such as 0.01.

entryFeeBps.description: Manager entry fee in basis points, 0 to 500. Default 0.

raiseDurationDays.description: Raise length in days, 1 to 30. Default 7.

minSkinBps.description: Manager skin requirement in basis points. 0 means the 5% default.

imageUri.description: https:// or ipfs:// image for the fund.

ref.description: Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

tools.name: polypad_prepare_fund_mint
tools.title: Prepare a fund investment
tools.description: Prepares minting shares of an open fund. Checks the raise is open, that public minting is open (the manager has to mint the required shares before anyone else), supply, and balance. Simulates, then returns unsigned transactions, a summary, and a signing link.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key.

confirmLarge.description: Set true only after the user confirmed an amount above 1 ETH.

ref.description: Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

tools.name: polypad_prepare_fund_redeem
tools.title: Prepare a fund exit or refund
tools.description: Prepares exiting a fund after its raise closes (pro-rata share of the vault) or a refund if the raise failed. Finds the wallet's shares on-chain, or takes a quantity or specific ids.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key.

quantity.description: How many shares, starting from the lowest ids. Default all.

ref.description: Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

tools.name: polypad_prepare_token_launch
tools.title: Prepare a token launch
tools.description: Prepares launching a new token on the Polypad factory, with the Agent-launched label by default. Validates every field, simulates createLaunch, and returns the unsigned transaction, a summary, and a signing link.

from.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key.

creatorFeeBps.description: Creator fee in basis points, 0 to 500. Required. 0 means 0%.

devBuyEth.description: Optional buy at launch, in wei.

ref.description: Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

tools.name: polypad_portfolio
tools.title: Wallet portfolio (read-only)
tools.description: Read-only view of a wallet: ETH, launch tokens with current exit value, fund shares with net value, and NFTs. Results are in ETH units from on-chain data. No USD value, no forecasts.

tools.name: polypad_get_tx_status
tools.title: Transaction status
tools.description: Follow up on a transaction: pending, confirmed, or failed, with a plain result (tokens bought, fund created, and so on) and an explorer link.

tools.name: polypad_stats
tools.title: Agent traffic stats
tools.description: Counts of actions prepared through the agent API by action and ref tag. Per server process; the on-chain attribution suffix is the durable record.
